purpose: Initial production qualification target. This is an engineering target, not accepted capacity or competitor parity.

measurementPolicy.latencyClock: Monotonic client clock for roundtrips; recipient delivery uses synchronized independently measured clocks with clock-error bounds. Report raw samples and uncertainty.
measurementPolicy.percentileConfidencePolicy: Report sample count and95percent confidence intervals. An upper confidence bound exceeding a target is unaccepted.
measurementPolicy.insufficientSampleBucket: UNACCEPTED; do not pool away a failing or under-sampled site/platform. Extend dedicated runs to reach the minimum. Repeated call setup cycles may end after stable connection; they supplement, never replace,600second call-quality workloads.
measurementPolicy.inventoryPolicy: Before any qualification, record exact release/build/device/OS/browser and measured network profiles per site/platform, fixed generator seed and canonical payload/fanout distributions. Missing inventory prevents acceptance.

workload.audioCallProfile: Two participants, Opus target32kbit/s per sender; include measured protocol and relay overhead.
workload.videoCallProfile: Two participants,720p30 target1.5Mbit/s video plus32kbit/s Opus per sender; include measured protocol and relay overhead.

integrityAndAvailability.overloadPolicy: Bound memory and queues; explicit retryable refusal with backoff; never acknowledge an uncommitted write or silently return partial history.
integrityAndAvailability.successDenominator: Every scheduled attempt counts, including retries, timeouts, refusals and transport failures. Also report eventual logical-operation success separately; a retry never erases a failed attempt.
integrityAndAvailability.faultWindowPolicy: Run named fault phases separately from normal sustained/peak phases. Publish their full attempt-error/latency distributions and time to drain; no injected-fault samples are silently dropped from combined totals.

costTargetsUsd.externalAiOrPaidMcpServices: Separate explicit user or agent budget; never silently included as unlimited infrastructure.
costTargetsUsd.verification: Capture actual provider usage, versioned published rates, retained storage, retries, fanout, calls and projected monthly idle/active duration; disclose taxes, fixed fees and exclusions.

durabilityFaultModel.unacknowledgedWrites: May be absent or committed after a lost response; exact operation retry must resolve the original durable result without a duplicate logical effect.
durabilityFaultModel.excludedCatastrophe: Simultaneous permanent loss of every independent durability and recovery domain. Document concrete domains and residual risk before production acceptance; do not relabel a tested primary failure as excluded.

monthlyCostReferenceUsage.remainingSecondsPerDay: No new synthetic writes/media/calls; retain connections at10percent of the sustained population, data, provider/device registrations and operational monitoring. Include actual idle cost.
monthlyCostReferenceUsage.callConcurrencyDuringActiveWindow: 25audio plus5video throughout7200seconds, each call cycles at600seconds; count both participants, relay traversal and retries.
monthlyCostReferenceUsage.backgroundPushAndAuth: One content-free wake per disconnected recipient device per new logical message,2devices per account;1provider sign-in per DAU per day plus measured token refresh and retries. Record actual delivery/fanout counts.
